verses.original: בְּךָֽ־ יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־ אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵā- Yah·weh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: In You O LORD I have taken refuge let me never . . . be put to shame
verses.literalPt: Em ti, Jeová, me refugio; não seja eu jamais envergonhado.

verses.original: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־ אֵלַ֥י אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā taṣ·ṣî·lê·nî ū·ṯə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî haṭ·ṭêh- ’ê·lay ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: In Your justice rescue and deliver me incline Your ear and save me
verses.literalPt: Livra-me na tua retidão e resgata-me; inclina para mim os teus ouvidos e salva-me.

verses.original: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־ סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hĕ·yêh lî lə·ṣūr mā·‘ō·wn lā·ḇō·w tā·mîḏ ṣiw·wî·ṯā lə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî kî- sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Be . . . my rock of refuge where I can always go Give the command to save me for You are my rock and my fortress
verses.literalPt: Sê para mim uma rocha de morada a que sempre me acolha. Tu hás ordenado que eu seja salvo, porquanto tu és a minha rocha e a minha fortaleza.

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hay pal·lə·ṭê·nî mî·yaḏ rā·šā‘ mik·kap̄ mə·‘aw·wêl wə·ḥō·mēṣ
verses.literal: Deliver me O my God from the hand of the wicked from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless
verses.literalPt: Livra-me, Deus meu, da mão do iníquo, do poder do malfeitor e do violento.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ṯiq·wā·ṯî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh miḇ·ṭa·ḥî min·nə·‘ū·rāy
verses.literal: For You are my hope O Lord GOD my confidence from my youth
verses.literalPt: Pois tu és a minha esperança, Senhor Jeová; és a minha confiança desde a minha mocidade.

verses.original: עָלֶ֤יךָ׀ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·le·ḵā nis·maḵ·tî mib·be·ṭen mim·mə·‘ê ’im·mî ’at·tāh ḡō·w·zî bə·ḵā ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî ṯā·mîḏ
verses.literal: I have leaned on You since birth You pulled me from my mother’s womb My praise is always for You
verses.literalPt: Em ti me tenho escorado desde que nasci; tu és aquele que me tiraste das entranhas de minha mãe. De ti se fará sempre o meu hino de louvor.

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־ עֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mō·w·p̄êṯ hā·yî·ṯî lə·rab·bîm wə·’at·tāh ma·ḥă·sî- ‘ōz
verses.literal: I have become a portent to many but You are my strong refuge
verses.literalPt: Tornei-me um portento para muitos, mas tu és o meu forte refúgio.

verses.original: יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yim·mā·lê p̄î tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm tip̄·’ar·te·ḵā
verses.literal: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long
verses.literalPt: A minha boca encher-se-á do teu louvor, e da tua glória, de contínuo.

verses.original: אַֽל־ תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־ תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- taš·lî·ḵê·nî lə·‘êṯ ziq·nāh kiḵ·lō·wṯ kō·ḥî ’al- ta·‘az·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: Do not discard me . . . in my old age do not forsake me when my strength fails
verses.literalPt: Não me enjeites no tempo da velhice; quando faltar a minha força, não me desampares.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mə·rū ’ō·wy·ḇay lî wə·šō·mə·rê nap̄·šî nō·w·‘ă·ṣū yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: For my enemies speak against me and those who lie in wait for my life conspire . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois falam de mim os meus inimigos, e os que espreitam a minha alma consultam juntos,

verses.original: לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ă·zā·ḇōw riḏ·p̄ū wə·ṯip̄·śū·hū kî- ’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: saying God has forsaken him pursue him and seize him for there is no one to rescue him
verses.literalPt: dizendo: Deus o desamparou; persegui-o e tomai-o, pois não há quem o livre.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־ תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חִישָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’al- tir·ḥaq mim·men·nî ’ĕ·lō·hay lə·‘ez·rā·ṯî ḥī·šå̄h
verses.literal: Be not far from me O God Hurry O my God to help me
verses.literalPt: Ó Deus, não te apartes de mim; Deus meu, dá-te pressa em me socorrer.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū yiḵ·lū śō·ṭə·nê nap̄·šî ya·‘ă·ṭū ḥer·pāh ū·ḵə·lim·māh mə·ḇaq·šê rā·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace
verses.literalPt: Sejam envergonhados e consumidos os que são adversários da minha alma; sejam cobertos de opróbrio e ignomínia os que buscam o meu mal.

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־ כָּל־ תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî tā·mîḏ ’ă·ya·ḥêl wə·hō·w·sap̄·tî ‘al- kāl- tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto a mim, sempre esperarei e ainda te louvarei mais e mais.

verses.original: פִּ֤י׀ יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כָּל־ הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: pî yə·sap·pêr ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm tə·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā kî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî sə·p̄ō·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long . . . though I cannot know their full measure
verses.literalPt: A minha boca relatará a tua justiça e a tua salvação, de contínuo, pois não lhes poderei saber o número.

verses.original: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇō·w biḡ·ḇu·rō·wṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’az·kîr ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā lə·ḇad·de·ḵā
verses.literal: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD I will proclaim Your righteousness Yours alone
verses.literalPt: Virei com os poderosos feitos do Senhor Jeová; farei menção da tua justiça, da tua tão somente.

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־ הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm lim·maḏ·ta·nî min·nə·‘ū·rāy wə·‘aḏ- hên·nāh ’ag·gîḏ nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: O God You have taught me from my youth and to this day . . . I proclaim Your marvelous deeds
verses.literalPt: Ó Deus, tu me tens ensinado desde a minha mocidade; e até agora tenho declarado as tuas maravilhas.

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם עַד־ זִקְנָ֨ה׀ וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל־ תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד־ אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל־ יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ‘aḏ- ziq·nāh wə·śê·ḇāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’al- ta·‘az·ḇê·nî ‘aḏ- ’ag·gîḏ zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā lə·ḏō·wr lə·ḵāl yā·ḇō·w gə·ḇū·rā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Even when I am old and gray do not forsake me O God until I proclaim Your power to the next generation Your might to all who are to come
verses.literalPt: Até à velhice e às cãs, ó Deus, não me desampares; até que eu tenha declarado a tua força à geração vindoura e o teu poder a todo o que há de vir.

verses.original: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־ מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘aḏ- mā·rō·wm ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯā ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mî ḵā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens O God You who have done great things Who O God is like You
verses.literalPt: A tua justiça, ó Deus, atinge os céus. Tu que tens feito grandezas; ó Deus, quem é semelhante a ti?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִרְאִיתַנוּ צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תְּחַיֵּינוּ וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer hir·ʾī·ṯa·nū ṣā·rō·wṯ rab·bō·wṯ wə·rā·‘ō·wṯ tā·šūḇ tə·ḥay·yē·nū ū·mit·tə·hō·mō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ tā·šūḇ ta·‘ă·lê·nî
verses.literal: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes You will revive me once again Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up
verses.literalPt: Tu, que nos fizeste ver muitas e penosas tribulações, de novo, nos restituirás à vida e, das profundezas da terra, nos tornarás a trazer.

verses.original: תֶּ֤רֶב׀ גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: te·reḇ gə·ḏul·lā·ṯî wə·ṯis·sōḇ tə·na·ḥă·mê·nî
verses.literal: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again
verses.literalPt: Aumenta a minha grandeza e torna a confortar-me.

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲנִ֤י׀ אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־ נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî ’ō·wḏ·ḵā ḇiḵ·lî- ne·ḇel ’ă·mit·tə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hāy ’ă·zam·mə·rāh lə·ḵā ḇə·ḵin·nō·wr qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So I will praise You with the harp . . . for Your faithfulness O my God I will sing praise to You with the lyre O Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: Eu também te darei graças ao som do saltério, celebrarei a tua verdade, Deus meu. Cantarei a ti louvores ao som da harpa, ó Santo de Israel.

verses.original: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־ לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ran·nên·nāh śə·p̲ā·t̲ai kî ’ă·zam·mə·rāh- lāḵ wə·nap̄·šî ’ă·šer pā·ḏî·ṯā
verses.literal: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy along with my soul which You have redeemed
verses.literalPt: Os meus lábios exultarão, quando eu cantar os teus louvores; exultará a minha alma, que tu remiste.

verses.original: גַּם־ לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־ חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- lə·šō·w·nî kāl- hay·yō·wm teh·geh ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā kî- ḇō·šū ḵî- ḥā·p̄ə·rū mə·ḇaq·šê rā·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long . . . for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded
verses.literalPt: Também a minha língua celebrará a tua justiça continuamente, porque estão envergonhados, porque estão confundidos os que buscam o meu mal.
